title: Restaurant Cook – Full Board Included
description: We are looking for a skilled cook to join our team at Green Leaf Café. The role involves preparing daily specials, managing breakfast and lunch service, and maintaining kitchen hygiene standards. Full board (accommodation + meals) is included. 5-day work week with 2 rotating days off.

title: Dive Instructor – Seasonal
description: Join our diving school for the high season (November – April). You will lead Open Water and Advanced courses, conduct fun dives, and assist with equipment maintenance. PADI Divemaster or Instructor certification required. Shared accommodation on the island provided.

title: English Teacher – Conversational Classes
description: Teach conversational English to adults and young learners at our established language school. Lesson plans are provided; creativity and enthusiasm are essential. TEFL/CELTA certificate preferred but not mandatory. A furnished apartment near the school is included in the package.

title: Barista & Café Host
description: A welcoming barista role at our busy city-centre café and co-working space. You will prepare specialty coffee, greet guests, manage table service during busy periods, and maintain the café's friendly atmosphere. Latte art skills are a bonus. Staff meals provided on shift.

title: Yoga Instructor – Eco Retreat
description: Guide guests through morning and sunset yoga sessions at our eco-retreat in the rice paddies of Ubud. Classes are mixed-level; teaching experience with beginners is important. A private bungalow and all three meals are provided, plus free wi-fi and a monthly visa allowance.

title: Farm Helper – Organic Permaculture
description: Help maintain our organic mountain farm north of Chiang Mai. Tasks include planting, composting, irrigation, and harvest. Accommodation in a shared eco-cabin is provided, along with three farm-grown meals a day. Ideal for anyone seeking a slow-living, off-grid experience.
